systems.name: Authentication
systems.plainDescription: Logs people in and creates sessions.

findings.technicalDescription: Accounts can create a password-only session when MFA is disabled.
findings.plainDescription: Some accounts rely on only one login check.

modularity.rationale: Session policy is mixed into creation.

findings.technicalDescription: Session creation also decides authentication assurance.
findings.plainDescription: Changing login policy could unexpectedly affect sessions.

security.rationale: Authorization exists but validation is thin.

findings.technicalDescription: Profile names are only truncated, not validated.
findings.plainDescription: Unexpected profile names may be accepted.

findings.technicalDescription: The endpoint loads every order without pagination.
findings.plainDescription: The order screen will slow down as the store grows.

deployment.rationale: Deployment relies on shared manual operations.

security.rationale: No concrete injection path is present.

findings.technicalDescription: Audit events have no user or time index.
findings.plainDescription: Looking up account history will slow down as records grow.

deployment.rationale: The migration has no documented rollback.

findings.technicalDescription: The migration does not include a rollback path.
findings.plainDescription: A failed database update would be difficult to undo.

modularity.rationale: The database client is an untyped global.

findings.technicalDescription: A global untyped client hides dependencies.
findings.plainDescription: Database changes can affect unrelated features.

findings.technicalDescription: Email validation is embedded in the component.
findings.plainDescription: Checkout rules may behave differently in different screens.

security.rationale: A local database address is used as a fallback.

findings.technicalDescription: Database configuration silently falls back to a local value.
findings.plainDescription: The service could connect to the wrong database.

deployment.rationale: Deployment is manual and has no rollback.

findings.technicalDescription: The deployment declares no rollback operation.
findings.plainDescription: A bad release would take longer to recover from.

systems.name: Automated Tests
systems.plainDescription: Runs basic checks for login and API responses.

deployment.rationale: Tests are not configured for a deterministic one-shot run.

findings.technicalDescription: The API test only checks that status exists.
findings.plainDescription: Important request behavior could break without a test noticing.
